description: Flat metadata schema for individual records from CLIP-seq-based RNA-binding protein interaction studies in vertebrate embryonic development.

record_id.descr: Unique identifier for the metadata record within the dataset.

species_common_name.descr: Common name of the vertebrate species studied, e.g., zebrafish, mouse, frog, chick.

species_scientific_name.descr: Scientific name of the organism, e.g., Danio rerio, Mus musculus, Xenopus laevis.

species_taxon_id.descr: NCBI Taxonomy identifier for the species.

developmental_stage_label.descr: Developmental stage of the sample using the study's reported stage label, e.g., HH10, E8.5, somite stage 12.

developmental_stage_ontology_id.descr: Ontology accession for the developmental stage when available, e.g., Uberon, developmental stage ontology, species-specific staging ontology.

developmental_stage_description.descr: Free-text description of the developmental stage, anatomical context, or staging criteria used.

sample_tissue_or_cell_type.descr: Tissue, cell type, embryo region, or developmental compartment from which the sample was obtained.

sample_anatomical_ontology_id.descr: Ontology accession for the tissue or cell type when available.

rbp_gene_symbol.descr: Official gene symbol of the RNA-binding protein investigated.

rbp_protein_name.descr: Full protein name of the RNA-binding protein.

rbp_identifier.descr: Stable protein or gene identifier such as UniProt accession, Ensembl gene ID, or RefSeq accession.

rbp_family.descr: RNA-binding protein family or domain class, e.g., RRM, KH, DEAD-box, PUF, STAR.

interaction_detection_method.descr: Primary method used to detect RNA-protein interactions, e.g., HITS-CLIP, PAR-CLIP, iCLIP, eCLIP.

interaction_detection_method_details.descr: Additional protocol details that distinguish the assay implementation, including adapter strategy, barcode scheme, or digestion conditions.

crosslinking_method.descr: Crosslinking approach used, e.g., UV 254 nm, UV 365 nm, formaldehyde, or other.

crosslinking_used.descr: Whether crosslinking was applied during sample preparation.

antibody_name.descr: Antibody used for immunoprecipitation, if applicable.

antibody_catalog_number.descr: Vendor catalog number or internal identifier for the antibody.

immunoprecipitation_target.descr: Molecular target enriched by immunoprecipitation, typically the RNA-binding protein.

library_strategy.descr: Sequencing library construction strategy, e.g., single-end, paired-end, stranded, UMI-tagged.

sequencing_platform.descr: High-throughput sequencing platform used, e.g., Illumina HiSeq, NovaSeq, NextSeq.

sequencing_layout.descr: Sequencing layout, e.g., single-end or paired-end.

reference_genome_build.descr: Reference genome assembly used for alignment, e.g., GRCm39, danRer11.

reference_transcriptome_build.descr: Transcriptome assembly or annotation version used, if applicable.

alignment_tool.descr: Software used for read alignment, e.g., Bowtie, STAR, HISAT2, BWA.

peak_calling_method.descr: Method or software used to identify interaction clusters or peaks.

peak_calling_parameters.descr: Key parameters or thresholds used for cluster/peak detection, recorded as free text.

significant_interaction_sites_count.descr: Number of significant RNA-binding sites, peaks, or clusters identified for the record.

interaction_score_or_signal_metric.descr: Quantitative score or signal metric summarizing interaction evidence, such as enrichment score, occupancy score, or read count normalized value.

interaction_threshold_value.descr: Threshold used to call significant interactions, such as FDR, p-value, or score cutoff.

threshold_type.descr: Type of threshold applied, e.g., FDR, p-value, fold-enrichment, posterior probability.

replicate_number.descr: Biological or technical replicate number associated with the record.

biological_replicate_count.descr: Total number of biological replicates included in the experiment.

technical_replicate_count.descr: Total number of technical replicates included in the experiment.

input_control_used.descr: Whether an input or control library was used for comparative peak calling or background correction.

control_sample_identifier.descr: Identifier for the matched control sample, if available.

rna_species_class.descr: Class of RNA enriched or analyzed, e.g., mRNA, pre-mRNA, lncRNA, miRNA, rRNA.

target_rna_annotation_source.descr: Annotation database or version used for RNA feature assignment, e.g., GENCODE, RefSeq, Ensembl.

developmental_process_annotation.descr: Biological process or developmental pathway relevant to the interaction record, e.g., neural differentiation, gastrulation, somitogenesis.

phenotype_or_function_summary.descr: Brief summary of observed functional consequence or phenotype linked to the RNA-binding protein interaction, if reported.

sample_collection_date.descr: Date when the biological sample was collected, if available.

experiment_date.descr: Date when the experiment or sequencing run was performed, if available.

data_release_date.descr: Date when the processed record or dataset entry was released.

pubmed_id.descr: PubMed identifier for the associated publication, if any.

doi.descr: Digital Object Identifier for the associated study, if any.

repository_accession.descr: Accession number in a public repository such as GEO, SRA, ArrayExpress, or ENA.

curation_notes.descr: Free-text curation notes, including ambiguities, missing values, or processing caveats.
